item.description: ROCHESTER, N.Y. (WROC) — Two Western New York Army Guard soldiers were among a group of six from Buffalo and Rochester to receive French medals for bravery on Sunday. item.description: BUFFALO, N.Y. (WIVB) -- Changes are coming to North Tonawanda's Dyngus Day Parade.
